'''2011 German National Championship Cedrik Vanderhaegen LS Tatooine: Slave Quarters''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
